notes.title: PC version!
notes.content:
[b]Wonder Games Team is happy to inform, that PC non-VR version of visual novel Guard of Wonderland will be released on 8th of November 2018![/b]

Steam link: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/924940/Guard_of_Wonderland/][/url]

notes.title: Richard «Levelord» Gray plays Guard of Wonderland VR
notes.content:
Richard «Levelord» Gray, legendary gamedesigner, who took part in development of such famous games as Doom, Blood, Duke Nukem 3D, Quake, Sin, Heavy Metal: F.A.K.K., Star Trek: Elite Force II, etc... Plays new VR novel Guard of Wonderland. His first impression and feedback on that.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=biaxYw4bKzc] Video [/url]
